t: Future-proofing My Tech: Linux, Python, Vim, Git, and now HTMX
s: The author reflects on a marathon coding session unifying projects, integrating HTMX for enhanced templating, and the evolving landscape of AI-assisted development, drawing parallels to historical tech shifts and missed opportunities.
